title: Hotfix, rollback or wait?
seo: BI release management drill: a production KPI is wrong after a release. Choose between a normal release, a hotfix and a rollback, and justify it.
summary: Release 2.3 went live last night. This morning one KPI on the sales app is wrong. The board pack is tomorrow. Choose: normal release, hotfix or rollback.
impact: Every option has a cost. Rolling back also undoes fixes people are waiting for; a rushed hotfix can break something else the day before the board pack; waiting leaves a wrong number in front of managers.

messages.subject: Avg order value is off
body: Avg Order Value on the sales app jumped from about $210 to $340 overnight. Nothing like that happened in the business. Managers are asking.
Your call; tell me by 10:00 and why. Release notes attached. Next normal release train is Thursday 15:00, after the board pack goes out.

evidence.title: Release 2.3 notes (deployed Tue 9 Jun, 18:00)
body:
- 14 changes. Includes: Staff exclusion fix for Finance (requested for the board pack), schema migration of FactReturns (new column ReturnChannel; the previous release can't read the new table), two new pages for Ops, and AOV now uses [Orders (completed)].
- All tests passed in Test. Rollback: redeploy release 2.2 from Git (requires reverting the FactReturns schema migration in the warehouse first).

evidence.title: The AOV change in release 2.3
evidence.body:
-- 2.2
Avg Order Value = DIVIDE ( [Net Sales (orders)], [Orders] )

-- 2.3
Avg Order Value = DIVIDE ( [Net Sales (orders)], [Orders (completed)] )
-- [Orders (completed)] = CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( FactSales[OrderID] ), FactSales[Status] = "Completed", FactSales[Channel] = "Online" )

decision.title: How to correct Avg Order Value in production
decision.question: What do you do?

options.t: Wait for Thursday's normal release train
options.d: No risk of a rushed change; the wrong KPI stays live until Thursday afternoon.

options.t: Hotfix: a one-line change to [Orders (completed)], tested and deployed today through the pipeline
options.d: Fast and small; needs a test and a deployment outside the train.
Restores the old AOV and everything else from before last night.

tasks: Find what's actually wrong in the AOV change.
Weigh the three options against the facts in the release notes.
Record your decision with its justification and the safeguards you'd require.

deliverables.t: Hotfix release note (if you chose it)

hints: Read [Orders (completed)] carefully: it filters more than its name says.
What else would a rollback take away, and what has to happen in the warehouse before 2.2 can even run?

rubric.good: Finds the extra Channel = "Online" filter that shrinks the denominator.

Chooses a tested hotfix; rejects rollback because it removes the Finance fix needed for the board pack and requires reverting a schema migration; rejects waiting because managers act on the KPI today.
Hotfix through the pipeline with a regression check of AOV and other KPIs, and a follow-up test so it can't recur.
Jordan and the managers told what was wrong and when it's fixed.

retro: Which test in Test would have caught this?
When is a rollback the right answer?
